summary: Diodes Incorporated filed an 8-K announcing completion of its all-cash acquisition of ElevATE Semiconductor for $250 million, per a July 10, 2026 merger agreement. The merger subsidiary merged into ElevATE, which survived as a wholly owned subsidiary. The deal expands Diodes' analog/mixed-signal portfolio in the ATE market. No premium, board recommendations, or advisors detailed in this filing; terms were previously disclosed. Watch for integration execution and potential synergies in high-growth semiconductor test markets.
